description: Interactive compile-and-inspect workflow using local GCC toolchains (S32Compiler GCC 10.2/11.4). Compiles C/C++ code, produces real assembly, and explains how the compiler transforms source into instructions for embedded ARM Cortex-M/R/A targets. Use when the user asks "what assembly does GCC generate", "how does -O2 optimize this loop", or wants to inspect ARM code generation.
